queries.question: What is the exact >8018/>96EA stairs fallback contract, and does it decide stairs acceptance?
queries.answer: >8018 is a BR-on-condition-reset tail trampoline into the shared >96EA acknowledgement routine, not a game-state predicate. Message >2D returns reset, so the stairs call enters >96EA. Nonzero >83A1 is cleared and returns immediately; zero selects waiting backdrop >0C/>02 from vdp_timer bit >40 and loops SCAN until a new key. VRAM >1D01 then selects final backdrop >06 when equal to >02, otherwise >03. Ordinary RTN at >9710 clears condition, so >66C5 branches to >663F without changing >1CF8 or >1D00. One frozen authentic case matched >8018 -> >96EA -> >9710 -> >66C5 -> >663F, new key >20, final backdrop >03, and no stairs mutation. Model v2 removes the guessed continuation_allowed Boolean; only absent new input remains an explicit wait/refusal.
